name: Kimo Sozoro
source:
She is Honori's childhood friend and attends the same university as Nariyuki and Hayuru.

She also works part-time at the same family restaurant as Hayuru.

With her straightforward personality, she doted on Honori like a younger sister.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=698944]getchu[/url]]
